subject: Lack of mandatory advertisements for supplements with green tea extract containing EGCG, on web shop from Luxembourg
product_category: Dietetic foods, food supplements and fortified foods
hazards_observed: Lack of mandatory mentions in the product information for several food supplements containing the ingredient epigallocatechin-3-gallate from green tea extracts. According to legislation 2022/2340, the label shall provide the maximum number of portions of the food for daily consumption and a warning not to consume a daily amount of 800 mg of (-)-epigallocatechin-3-gallate or more. The label shall indicate the content of (-)- epigallocatechin-3-gallate per portion of the food. The label shall include the following warnings: “Should not be consumed if you are consuming other products containing green tea on the same day”, “Should not be consumed by pregnant or lactating women and children below 18 years old” and “Should not be consumed on an empty stomach”. In addition, we also identified health claims that are non-compliant with regulation 1924/2006.
